findings.title: Drain half of fix has no test covering removal of queue-ready wait
findings.claim: The hook (also tests/unit/rpc_test.cc:2010-2017) fires only after data_sink::close() is entered, when the flag is already set and the queue is empty; if the wait on _outgoing_queue_ready were removed, the test would still pass, and a frame queued just before the flag would again be written into the closed stream.

findings.title: Test doesn't verify hook fails with closed_error
findings.claim: The try/catch passes whether the hook succeeds or throws, so a change that silently drops the frame and returns a ready future would still pass, even though commit 5e25ebdb says the hook should fail with closed_error.

findings.title: Docs wrongly claim a throw from reading closes the source
findings.claim: If deserialization throws inside process_one_buffer, close_source() is never called so _source_closed stays false (also include/seastar/rpc/rpc_types.hh:386-387); an application that stops reading at that throw, as the docs allow, never runs stream_close().

findings.title: Docs wrongly state connection shuts down only once both halves are closed
findings.claim: The connection is also shut down on peer eof, on errors, and by abort_all_streams(); line 49 of the same doc says closing the client aborts the stream, contradicting this statement.

findings.title: Test header comment describes old behaviour in present tense
findings.claim: The comment says send() 'still accepts frames' in the window, which is no longer true after the fix.

findings.title: put(std::span) override missing SEASTAR_API_LEVEL guard
findings.claim: The put(std::span) override has no #if SEASTAR_API_LEVEL >= 9 guard, unlike every other test sink in the tree (e.g. tests/unit/loopback_socket.hh:144), so rpc_test doesn't compile at API levels 7 or 8.

findings.title: Comment wrongly says _outgoing_queue_ready is exceptional if an entry failed
findings.claim: A failed entry still resolves with a value (rpc.cc:338); the future only becomes exceptional when negotiation is aborted, contradicting the comment.

findings.title: Misleading comment claims yield() runs the batch flush poller
findings.claim: The comment 'Let the batch flush poller run' is wrong: yield() only queues a task and doesn't make the reactor poll; the late write is actually caught during the later blocking .get() calls.

findings.title: const_cast on this used where file convention is a mutable member
findings.claim: The code uses const_cast on this, whereas the existing compressor factory in the same file (rpc_test.cc:330) declares a mutable member instead.

findings.title: Comment about what still waits on _outgoing_queue_ready
findings.claim: Claude flagged the comment at rpc.cc:559 describing what still waits on _outgoing_queue_ready as incorrect; Codex reviewed it and rejected the finding.

findings.title: _stream_closing duplicates state already tracked by _error
findings.claim: Claude raised that adding _stream_closing alongside _error introduces duplicated state; Codex reviewed it and rejected the finding.

findings.title: close_entered_cv wait in test has no timeout
findings.claim: Claude flagged that the close_entered_cv wait in the test has no timeout; Codex reviewed it and rejected the finding.

findings.title: Claude Co-Authored-By trailers flagged as an issue
findings.claim: A lead about Claude Co-Authored-By trailers was dropped before adjudication because that rule comes from the reviewer's personal instructions rather than the repository, and the base history already contains similar trailers.
